entries.words: {appearance}. One whole creature with all of its body in view, seen from the front left and a little above, alone against a plain white background, soft even light, a smooth solid figure with gentle shading.
entries.reason: Route P's first framing: one figure alone on white, its whole body in view, so the cut-out takes all of it and the 3D model has every limb to fit; no colour words, which belong to the recipe and the colour step. Measured on 15 October 2026 on a development set of models made from pictures, ten in this wording and ten in the limbs-apart wording from the same descriptions: six of the ten in this wording fitted the plan's skeleton with moving chains, against five of ten in the other.

entries.words: {appearance}. One whole creature with all of its body in view, its legs a little apart and its arms, wings, fins or tentacles held a little away from its body, seen from the front left and a little above, alone against a plain white background, soft even light, a smooth solid figure with gentle shading.
entries.reason: The whole-body framing asking for limbs held away from the body, for a model whose limbs would otherwise merge with its body. Measured on 15 October 2026 on the same development set: five of ten fitted with moving chains, against six of ten in the whole-body wording, so it is an alternative to try, not the first framing.
